topic.title: A home loan at 8.5% moves to 8.75%: what the small rise adds over the loan

title: Home loan rate up from 8.5% to 8.75%: the cost hiding in a small rise
description: A ₹50 lakh, 20-year home loan whose rate moves from 8.5% to 8.75%. We compute the new EMI and the extra interest over the full loan. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.

lines.text: ₹56.0 L in interest. On just one home loan.
The EMI goes from ₹43,391 to ₹44,186. Looks small.
But interest eats a little more, every month, for 240 months.
Total interest goes from ₹54.1 L to ₹56.0 L.
Some banks keep the EMI and stretch the loan instead. Either way, you pay more interest.
Check your loan statement. Follow for one money idea a day.
